title: A board member asks for the cap table
scenario: A board member’s personal email asks finance to send the latest cap table and option-grant details to a private address before a flight. The request sounds plausible and time-sensitive.

answers.A: Verify the request and approved delivery channel through corporate governance/legal processes before sending sensitive data.
answers.B: Ask the board member to retrieve the information through the board portal or approved document system.
answers.C: Send a password-protected file to the personal email and share the password by text.

explanation: Encryption does not fix an unverified recipient or unauthorized channel. Governance data should stay inside approved systems.
proTip: Protect the identity and channel before protecting the attachment.
